audit.why: 53.13% WR over 1022 games, Naafiri-favoured until late. Immobile artillery enemy with a projectile-reflect: early and mid are Naafiri's, 2+ items tips to Mel via Overwhelm execute scaling. EVEN 5.5/10 is defensible.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows; content and packet agree Naafiri 1 through first item, Mel at 2+ items. phases[6].why described Naafiri winning a stage the content gives to Mel.
audit.why: Mel's kit has no escape ultimate — Naafiri's 900-range R dive wins every stage until Overwhelm stacking and rank-5 Rebuttal (26s CD, reflects her Q daggers) outscale the burst window.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with matching whys and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content claimed Rebuttal 'reflects and stuns you' in three places — the kit says W reflects projectiles, prevents damage and grants movement speed; no stun exists. Naafiri's dash again misattributed to 'W The Hunt' (kit: W is the untargetable pack-empower, R is the champion dash). Sixteen misgender hits — Mel is she/her.
audit.why: Kit text is authority; a fabricated stun teaches players to fear a CC that never comes.
audit.corrected: Stun claims replaced with the real mechanic (dagger reflect / damage immunity), W/R naming fixed, all pronouns corrected.

edits.before: Mel is an immobile artillery mage who leans on her Q Radiant Volley stacks and W Rebuttal reflect, so your job is to force trades when W is down. Bait or wait out her W shield, then commit Q daggers into W The Hunt; if you dash in while Rebuttal is up she reflects and stuns you, so watch that cooldown above all. With no dash of her own, a single clean W engage chunks her hard.
edits.after: Mel is an immobile artillery mage who leans on her Q Radiant Volley stacks and W Rebuttal reflect, so your job is to force trades when W is down. Bait or wait out her W shield, then commit Q daggers into your dash; if you throw daggers while Rebuttal glows she reflects them back at you, so watch that cooldown above all. With no dash of her own, a single clean R engage chunks her hard.

edits.before: Your R Call of the Pack is a hard equalizer into an immobile target: pop it, W onto her when Rebuttal is down, and the pack plus movement speed runs her out of escape options. She has no mobility ultimate to peel your dive, so six is firmly your all-in window. Just sequence it after her W, because eating a reflected stun mid-R wastes your whole cooldown.
edits.after: Your R dive is a hard equalizer into an immobile target: pop W for the surge, R onto her when Rebuttal is down, and the pack plus movement speed runs her out of escape options. She has no mobility ultimate to peel your dive, so six is firmly your all-in window. Just sequence it after her W, because diving a damage-immune Rebuttal wastes your whole cooldown.

edits.before: At 2+ items Mel's Q stacks scale into serious execute damage and her W Rebuttal can reflect your all-in burst back at you, which is why late favour tips to her. Her ultimate's ramping missiles punish grouped packmates, and if she times W on your W dash she both survives and stuns you. Flank so she can't see the dash coming, force the reflect early, then commit only once it's down.
